title: ManageEngine Key Manager Plus versions before 7150 are vulnerable to a Two-Factor Authentication bypass that allows…
description: ManageEngine Key Manager Plus versions before 7150 contain a vulnerability that allows bypassing Two-Factor Authentication (2FA). An attacker with valid credentials can log in without providing the required verification code, potentially leading to unauthorized access. This vulnerability has a high severity score of 7.4 and is identified as CWE-288 (Authentication Bypass).
